_comment: Software safety limits. Tighter than the hardware range on purpose. Joint angles in degrees (LeRobot SO101Follower with use_degrees=True); gripper in percent open (0-100). Read by both the arm server and the independent Claude Code hook. Re-check every value against the real arm after calibration.

approach._comment: Same-direction approach to cancel backlash. +1 = finish moving toward larger angles. Best side per joint is a Phase 0 experiment.
